values.label: Tolerance over the PO balance (percent)
values.help: How far above the remaining PO balance an invoice may go, as a percentage of that balance.

values.label: Tolerance over the PO balance (amount)
values.help: The same limit as an amount, in the invoice's / PO's currency (the global default has no currency).

values.label: How the two tolerance limits combine
values.help: Both limits (the smaller one applies, stricter) or either limit (the larger one applies).

values.label: Required-field confidence threshold
values.help: A required field read with less confidence than this sends the invoice to review.

values.label: Near-duplicate window (days)
values.help: Same vendor and amount, a different number, and invoice dates within this many days count as a near-duplicate.

values.label: Near-duplicate amount tolerance
values.help: How far apart two amounts may be and still count as the same (0 = exact).

rules.name: Lines, tax and totals are consistent
Invoice currency matches the PO's currency
Not an exact duplicate of a prior invoice
rules.reason: Locked: an exact duplicate must always be caught.

rules.name: Not a near-duplicate of a prior invoice
Invoice line prices match the PO line prices
PO is not already fully billed
Invoice within tolerance of PO balance
Invoice vendor matches the PO's vendor
Vendor is approved (not blocked)
rules.reason: Locked: a blocked or unknown vendor must always be caught.

floors.name: Engine floor
floors.reason: Always on: the system's own minimum checks (confident PO match, comparable amount, required fields), not a rule.

floors.name: Reference floor
floors.reason: Always on: a PO reached through a resembling or unmatched printed reference is never auto-approved.
